custom_logic_notes: This EA uses an ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange) model trained on Larry Williams pattern recognition data. The .onnx model file must be present in the MQL5/Files directory. Signal generation relies entirely on neural network inference via OnnxCreate/OnnxRun API calls, making it impossible to port without the trained model and a compatible ONNX runtime in Python. Larry Williams %R or similar momentum concepts likely inform the model input features.
python_conversion_notes: Requires ONNX runtime (onnxruntime Python package) to load and run the .onnx model. The model file itself must be extracted from the MQ5 download package. Input preprocessing must exactly match what the MT5 EA does before feeding data to OnnxRun. Without the .onnx model file, this EA cannot be converted. If the model file is available, use onnxruntime.InferenceSession to replicate signal generation. Pay careful attention to input tensor shape and dtype matching the ONNX model's expected format.
